descriptor: Korean moisturising skincare: Sahara EXO-PDRN Cream, 70 ml, and the planned Oatmeal range.
about: OANIC GLOBAL CO., LTD. develops skincare for dry skin. Its range is organised around different degrees of dryness and moisture needs. Sahara is a finished product; the Oatmeal extension remains at the pre-launch stage.

lines.name: Sahara
lines.note: A cream for skin that still feels dry and tight after routine moisturising. Volume: 70 ml. In its email of 14 September 2026, OANIC confirmed Sahara was ready for commercial supply; each order requires separate agreement on terms.

lines.name: Oatmeal
lines.note: In its email of 3 September 2026, OANIC planned an October 2026 launch for three Level 3 creams: Deep Moisture, Calming Moisture and Anti-Aging Moisture. Launch is not confirmed. Sachet samples are available for testing. An expression of interest is not an order, payment, stock reservation or shipment.

tech.name: Declared ingredient levels
tech.note: OANIC reports the following Sahara ingredient levels; these are not a full INCI list or concentrations of pure active substances. Ingredient properties do not establish the efficacy of the finished cream. Cica Exosome 10,000 ppm · 10-Type Hyaluronic Acid 10,000 ppm · Salmon PDRN 1,000 ppm · 5-Ceramide Nanosome 1,000 ppm · 4-EGF Complex 1,000 ppm · Panthenol 1,000 ppm · Niacinamide 20,000 ppm · Adenosine 400 ppm.

tech.name: Results reported by OANIC
tech.note: OANIC’s B2B proposal reports average hydration increases of 110.14% after one application and 55.28% after 72 hours, with an average TEWL reduction of 12.48%. An irritation index of 0.00 is reported for a test with 30 sensitive-skin participants. These are company-reported results, not a promise of individual outcomes.

tech.name: Information awaiting confirmation
tech.note: The test provider and full protocols, hydration-study sample size, full INCI, manufacturer and factory, certifications and registrations are not confirmed by the supplied documents. Export MOQ, Incoterms, lead time and exclusivity also need confirmation for each export enquiry.

exportNote: OANIC’s materials state that Sahara was stocked by 26 Korean pharmacies as of August 2026. This is dated company information. Export terms are discussed for the specific market through Teranova.
